licensedStores.label: Licensed stores

employees.label: Employees

notes: Everything is from the FY2024 Form 10-K (fiscal year ended Sep 29, 2024). The 10-K gives store counts by market, not by U.S. state, so usStates is null; Starbucks publishes no state table in the 10-K and none was taken from other years or store-locator data. Company-operated and licensed stores are kept as separate metrics (the U.K., U.S. and Canada appear in both tables; they are not added). 'All Other' (71 company-operated, 4,369 licensed) and Siren Retail rows are residuals and are not shown. Latin America is the 10-K's licensed-store grouping with no country list. Employees are approximate: 211,000 in the U.S. and 150,000 outside it (no country split). Long-lived assets are given only for the U.S., China and 'Other countries'. Sites are the full Item 2 table of material properties.
